stem: According to mathematical modelling, what is the predicted life expectancy for a patient treated with modern triple-combination modulators compared with basic supportive care?
explanation: 71.6 years versus 38 years is the predicted life expectancy with modern triple-combination modulators compared with basic supportive care. This is because the modelling suggests a substantial improvement in survival with advanced modulator therapy.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because this is the predicted life expectancy with modern triple-combination modulators compared with basic supportive care.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because this underestimates the expected benefit of modern triple-combination modulators.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because these figures are higher than the predicted modelled life expectancy for this comparison.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the lower survival figure is not the modelled outcome for modern triple-combination modulators versus supportive care.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because this pair does not match the predicted life expectancy estimates from the model.

source.hint: The new treatment is predicted to extend life well into the seventh decade.
